name: Column

props.name: lg
props.description: Specify column span for the `lg` breakpoint (Default breakpoint up to 1312px) This breakpoint supports 16 columns by default.

props.name: max
props.description: Specify column span for the `max` breakpoint. This breakpoint supports 16 columns by default.

props.name: md
props.description: Specify column span for the `md` breakpoint (Default breakpoint up to 1056px) This breakpoint supports 8 columns by default.

props.name: sm
props.description: Specify column span for the `sm` breakpoint (Default breakpoint up to 672px) This breakpoint supports 4 columns by default.

props.name: span
props.description: Specify constant column span, start, or end values that will not change based on breakpoint

props.name: xlg
props.description: Specify column span for the `xlg` breakpoint (Default breakpoint up to 1584px) This breakpoint supports 16 columns by default.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon Column rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
